entries.name: UOB Empire
entries.content:
Union of the Blizzard (UOB) is an organization that seeks to bring about and maintain peace to the known universe. It is one the seven empires that rule over the known galaxies. Their territory is the Solstellar Galaxy.

Their main headquarters is located on Axea, a frigid planet of ice and snow. Nothing is known about it, since only the top officials are allowed to go there.

They are a benevolent empire, often seeking the best for their own and others. But they are also protective and powerful, as they will not hesitate to go to arms if they or innocent people are being threatened.

The UOB Stellarch is Christopher Pro, a being rumored to be over a thousand years old and filled with wisdom.

entries.name: Scrapyard
entries.content:
The Scrapyard is where half of all UOB-aligned starcrafts go when decommissioned or damaged beyond repair. Many people make a living off of scavenging from the Scrapyard illegally and reselling it. For the more honest folk, they obtain a scrapper license to have legal access to parts and materials in order to fix ships, either for private commissions or the UOB empire. 

It is said that it's possible to find almost any part needed to build an entire ship from scratch, but the skills needed to do so are far and few in between. Thieves steal and resell parts illegally, since if they had a scrapper license and resold a part on the black market, it could be traced back to their license ID.

entries.name: Centauri T-1690
entries.content:
Centauri T-1690 is an urban planet located in the Stellaris galaxy. It is one of the six districts of the UOB Empire and is mostly known for being the hub for all imports and exports. 

The environment is mostly man-made with concrete, steel and titanium structures, as 60% of the planet is developed. Outside of the cities, the natural flora is blue grass and trees similar to Earth. Most of the fauna is similar to Earth's with some changes like deer being green and white instead of brown and cream.

There is also the Scrapyard that is located on the edges of the city.

entries.name: RUSTE
entries.content:
RUSTE II is the name of the spaceship that {{user}} owns, is the captain of and travels the universe with. It is a repurposed cargo ship, modified and fitted with discarded, scavenged and traded parts, devices and appliances to be able to keep up with modern spaceships. 

The ship houses a Captain's quarters, medical bay, storage room, 90mm railguns, energy shield, crew quarters, dining room, lounge area and a shared bathroom.

Due to its previous exploits as a cargo ship that was designed for transport through dangerous territories, it was built to be very durable and very forgiving in terms of repairability. Though it's speed is not up to snuff with faster ships, it makes up in endurance with layers of redundancy and self-defense weapons in cases of attack.

{{user}}’s father owned the ship originally, the RUSTE I. It served him faithfully throughout many years of difficult and trying times, having the endearing nickname of “Old Reliable”. A motto painted in the cockpit is, “I may not get you there fast or in one piece, but by God, I'll get you there.” in referring to the ship itself.

It's autopilot and on-board AI persona is set to "old timey cowboy", and {{user}}'s father neglected to tell them how to change it, so it's stuck as so.

entries.name: Fallen Empire
entries.content:
The Fallen Empire is an ultratech refugee society from the planet Sophiamunda. Their culture is based on a code of honor, a strict class system, and enforced social stasis.

They are one the seven empires that rule the known universe. Their territory is the Cosmellar Galaxy. 

They have a strong resemblance to Greek society with their architecture and social hierarchy. Honor is highly valued, as the empire refuses to trade with parties who have no standing within their society higher than a damn or duchess.

The Fallen Empire produces and uses Hussars for their army. Additionally, they have a monopoly of psylink neuroformers, turning elderly nobles with high honor into Bestowers with psycasting abilities.

entries.name: Hussars
entries.content:
The Fallen Empire uses genetic modification to manually and artificially breed their own version of supersoldier. Hussars are never born, they are made.

Hussars have red eyes, innate muscular builds and are all at least 7” tall to have a menacing presence. Hussars are 1.5 times bigger than baseline humans, towering over them. They have enhanced strength and durability above the level of average humans. In addition, their bodies have a double healing factor than that of regular people, recovering from injuries quicker than normal. Due to genetic breeding, they have incredible skill in handling firearms and all melee weapons including hand-to-hand combat. They are also bred to be psychically deaf, unable to be mentally affected by psychic phenomena.

A side effect of the genetic breeding is that hussars have a hard time with social interactions, as they end up being awkward when they try to talk to others and their appearance makes others afraid of them. They also have a negative gene that makes them tend to be aggressive; paired with their poor social skills often leads to misunderstandings and fights.

As a way to keep hussars in line, the Fallen Empire bred them to have a genetic dependency on Go-juice. After a month without it, they will begin to experience withdrawal symptoms such as migraines, occasional nausea, vomiting, dizziness and blurred vision. After 2 months, the symptoms will worsen and intensify, eventually falling into a coma. After 3 months, the hussar will die unless immediately given Go-juice.

entries.name: Eldernica
entries.content:
Eldernica is a planet found in the Solstellar Galaxy. 

It is an extremely harsh terrain consisting of almost entirely sharp rocks and jagged peaks. It is infested with large drakes and dragons who dominate the ecosystem. These drakes breathe fire and have incredible power. A perpetual, planet-wide lightning storm roams 24/7, spewing orange lighting that explodes in a fiery blast upon hitting earth. Bayle the Dread is also rumored to live on this planet.

Surprisingly, humans live on this planet known as dragoons. They live there, cultivating the rich soil for agriculture and hunting the dragons for meat. Drake blood also serves as an enhancement drug, empowering the user with an intoxicating sense of power and strength that has been known to be addictive. 

After centuries, some have had their DNA altered from ingesting so much dragon and drake related items, becoming Glintscales. Eldernica is known as the birthplace and home of Glintscales.

entries.content:
A Glintscale is a genetically altered xenohuman that resembles a dragon.

Glintscales have adamantium scales that cover their body, serving as an incredibly strong natural armor. Sometimes, they grow dragon-like snouts and teeth as well as large horns. They have sharp retractable claws that ignite at will, burning at temperatures high enough to weld steel. Thanks to their scales, Glintscales are immune to extreme heat and cannot be burned.

Another ability of Glintscales is the ability to breathe fire from glands in the back of their throat. They also have dragon wings on their back that allow them to fly short distances. They are also capable of puffing aurum into the air before igniting it, causing a fiery explosion around themselves while remaining unharmed.

The drawback to their genetics is that they require Aurum, a broken down substance made of precious minerals like gold and silver, to flow through their bloodstream. They have strong teeth, so they can easily bite and eat a gold bar as if it was a granola bar. Without aurum, a Glintscale will not be able to use their dragon abilities (flying, fire breathing, using their claws, etc). Due to the metallic nature of the aurum in their blood, they are susceptible to being stunned by EMP waves, as it will cause them searing pain all over their body.

Glintscales are also genetically predisposed to aggression and jealousy, having a dragon-like avarice for wealth

entries.name: Solstellar Galaxy
entries.content:
Solstellar Galaxy is the territory of the UOB Empire. It is known to be one of the more successful territories due to the UOB’s intelligence, kindness and power in regards to its people. It's located between the Lunallar Galaxy and the Cosmellar Galaxy.

The planets and locations found in the Solstellar Galaxy are:
Centauri T-1690
Eldernica 
Numa Anum
Lanoog
Axea
Peppepe
O-4242
Oscillatus
Ignisia 
Massy Space Station

entries.name: O-4242
entries.content:
O-4242 is a planet in the Solstellar Galaxy. This planet is mostly desolate deserts with a vast cave system that spans the entire crust of the planet. 

A vast supply of valuable minerals and ores have been found on this planet, so it's mostly used as a mining outpost for the UOB Empire. Mining communities have been established here, and the UOB allows the residents to stay here with a 20% tax on all non-imperial sales of minerals and ores mined.

Unfortunately, due to the high rate of financial exchanges and business deals, bandits and pirates began lurking around O-4242. They often attack trading ships carrying ores or money to or from the planet, stealing all of it and sometimes killing the crew members. The UOB is currently engaged in an on-going battle to combat the piracy and protect the resident miners.

A dangerous animal known as Tremor Wyrms roam the planet as Apex predators.

A dangerous material was discovered here, known as the “Steel Cancer” or “SC” for short. It acts like advanced rust, devouring and eating away at metal like a disease. It transfers from surface to surface via physical touch. It's harmless to living beings, but poses a danger to all vehicles and metallic ores found. Many ships have failed and killed their crew due to the SC eating away at the ship from accidental transfer.

entries.name: Axea
entries.content:
Axea is a planet in the Solstellar Galaxy. This planet is used as the headquarters for the UOB Empire, the Glacial Citadel.

Axea is a barren planet, made of nothing but wastelands of ice and snow. Intense blizzards cover most of the planet year-round, leaving waist-deep snow.

No one is allowed to land on the planet unless given express permission from the UOB Empire. Unauthorized spacecrafts attempting to land on the planet will be immediately shot down after one or two attempts of contact for the most.

entries.name: Numa Anum
entries.content:
Numa Anum is a planet in the Solstellar Galaxy. The capital city of the Solstellar Galaxy is built here. This planet is a mostly tropical and oceanic planet with islands, vast expanses of waist-deep ocean water and deep trenches.

The biome of this planet is tropical and very hospitable for sustaining life. 95% of the planet is covered in shallow ocean water that only goes up to the hip at its deepest. 4% is islands that jut out of sea with green grass, granite stone, various types of fruit trees and small animals. The remaining 1% is a large trench that spans the entire circumference of the planet, going down hundreds of miles past the planet’s crust.

Solste, the capital city of the Solstellar Galaxy, is built here. Due to the inviting climate of the planet, this is the first stop of any visitors from other galaxies. Most of all commercial matters filter through Solste, as well as most of the interactions between the UOB and the populace. Over time, a thriving metropolis was developed over the waters of Numa Anum, maintaining a healthy balance with the natural ecosystem.

The population is 1.2 million people who live here full time, but more than 3 million can be found at any given moment in time.

entries.name: Peppepe
entries.content:
Peppepe is a planet in the Solstellar Galaxy.

This planet is covered in lush rainforest, swamps and jungles and is teeming with flora and fauna. Tribes of native people live here with varying cultures and levels of aggression.

There are gentle tribes who prefer to be at peace with their neighbors and travelers. There are also fierce and/or cannibalistic tribes that are highly aggressive, commonly attacking any outsiders on sight. Fortunately, the tech level of this planet is tribalistic and primitive, so they use crude weapons like rock slings, wooden spears and stone hatchets.

However, some tribes make up in their crude technology with psycasting. By meditating to and establishing a link with an Anima tree, some tribals gain the ability to use psycasts. The Anima tree is found nowhere else in the universe and only those who have a deep connection with nature have a hope at connecting with the Anima tree.

entries.name: Anima
entries.content:
Found on planet Peppepe are strange trees known as the Anima trees. It has strange markings in it that no human ever made, and it's leaves glow teal. It said in myths and legends among tribals that the tree is a connection to a higher, divine consciousness.

Tribals (or those who have a strong connection with nature) can meditate to the tree. This will begin to open the connection, and anima grass (teal glowing grass) will start to grow around the tree. After a certain amount of anima grass has grown, a ritual can be performed to grant the mediator a psylink and a level of psycasting abilities.

The ritual can be done on the same person multiple times, adding a psylink level every time. If the anima tree is cut down, it will emit a psychic scream, causing psychological/psychic pain in every conscious person planet-wide, lasting up to a day.

entries.name: Lanoog
entries.content:
Lanoog is a planet in the Solstellar Galaxy. This planet is used as the prison for the UOB.

This planet is an oceanic planet, with nothing but a single island of sharp, jagged black rock. The waves are in a constant state of rough waves and turbulence along with a neverending rainstorm. The ocean is deep, spanning millions of fathoms deep.

On the sole island is the Obelisk, a maximum-security prison for the most dangerous of criminals sentenced by the UOB. Here, executions are done by either a lethal injection or being thrown into the ocean, depending on the severity of the crime.

The Obelisk has been in use for over hundreds of years, and no prisoner has ever escaped once. Special material in the walls of the prison inhibit the use of any type of genetic or psychic abilities a prisoner may have.

entries.name: Psycasting
entries.content:
Psycasting is when a person uses psychic abilities to manipulate the world around them, mostly by psychically “convincing” outside factors to bend to the user's will. There are five levels of psylinks, with level 1 being small, everyday things while level 5 being serious effects like summoning a thunderstorm.

When a psycaster uses an ability, they generate neural heat which is chaotic psychic energy that builds up in the user's mind. It dissipates after a few seconds or minutes, depending on how much is generated. The stronger the psycast, the more neural heat generated. If a psycaster goes over their natural limit of neural heat, they stand at risk of psychic breakdown; a deep psychic destabilization of the mind. Psychic breakdown last for days, causing mental disturbances of various kinds but it resolves itself with time.

When a person gains a psylink level for the first time, they can choose the path of their psycasting abilities. They are:	
Archon - manipulating minds of others as a leader 
Chronopath - manipulating time (but cannot time travel)
Conflagrator - pyromancy 
Empath - manipulating emotions
Frostshaper - manipulating ice and snow
Necropath - manipulating the dead (necromancy)
Nightstalker - manipulating shadows and darkness
Protector - supporting and healing 
Skipmaster - teleportation 
Staticlord - manipulating electricity 
Technomancer - manipulating technological/physical items like steel and wood
Warlord - self buffs for offensive capabilities 
Wildspeaker - manipulating nature

entries.name: Go-juice
entries.content:
Go-juice is a performance enhancing drug, produced from the psychite plant. It is mainly manufacturered by the Fallen Empire, but it is not difficult to make at home with a makeshift drug lab.

Go-juice (often abbreviated as GJ) comes as a bottle filled with a green liquid that has a nutty, salty taste that leaves a buzzing mouth feel. It's primary use is in combat as a way to temporarily improve the user's combat capabilities, at the risk of being addictive.

Go-juice steadies the user's nerves and muscles, allowing them to fire guns and firearms more accurately. It increases the metabolism, giving a boost of energy levels and increasing movement speed. It also enhances the user's perception skills, allowing them to move more nimbly.

A common way of describing the effects are, as many users would say, “I feel hyper but steady. Sharper than the edge of a knife. I am the bullet in flight, ready to cut through you.”

entries.name: Massy Station
entries.content:
Massy Space Station (MSS) is a space station built by the UOB Empire as a rest spot and convenience store for all space travelers.

It's a massive man-made complex that floats in space, cycling between spots on common flight paths every month. It has a parking garage for ships of all sizes to land and dock. It has a forcefield around it that generates artificial gravity as well as providing a breathable atmosphere. It has a giant energy shield that can be activated to protect from hostile attacks as well as giant plasmacannons.

The interior is like a giant space mall, filled with various stores and outlets. In the center is a UOB-ran spaceship repair centre where Travelers can bring their ship to either repair it themselves or get it repaired by professionals. There are also cafés and restaurants here for relaxing.

entries.name: Felicia Bolt
entries.content:
Name: Felicia Bolt

Age: 19

Gender: Female 

Species: Human

Background: Felicia is a freelance mechanic whose dream is to become the best and most famous mechanic galaxy-wide.

History: From a young age, Felicia had a love for machinery and engineering, wanting to be the head mechanic for the UOB Empire someday. She entered the school for learning mechanics, but faced a hard time of being seen as a child by her fellow classmates. Felicia was always looked down upon or treated as if she was fragile due to her short height and baby-face appearance. She got into many fist fights in retaliation to this, and ended up being kicked out of the school. From then on, she took odd repair and fabrication jobs to make ends meet. Her dream is to be the most famous mechanic across the galaxy. After hearing about {{user}}'s beginning adventure, she stowawayed on their ship as soon as {{user}} took off, inviting herself onto the crew as their first crew member. Felicia has been on the crew from day one of the adventure.

Personality: stubborn, loud-mouthed, foul-mouthed, brazen, bold, scrappy 

Likes: mechanics, engineering, fixing, grilled cheese sandwiches, going fast

Dislikes: being called cute or short, headpats, posh people, wealthy folks, arrogance 

Behavior: Felicia considers her young looks a curse and acts wildly to combat the usual cutesy treatment she gets. She is very foul-mouthed, often slinging slurs and curse words in normal conversation. She hates being called cute, short or any other related term, and will almost always respond by punching the other person in the gut. She has a loud mouth, often speaking her mind before thinking and constantly getting herself in trouble. Despite her rough personality, she is secretly a maiden at heart who simply wants to love and be treated equally (but she would rather die than admit it out loud).

Goal: Felicia wants to become the most famous mechanic galaxy-wide, but she feels stifled on her home planet, Centauri T-1690. She heard about {{user}}'s plans to become a space explorer, and decided to try to join their crew as a way to make her name known.

entries.name: Monosword
entries.content:
A monosword is an ultratech sword manufactured solely by the Fallen Empire. It is compatible with persona chips.

The monosword can activate it's ability to cause it's edge to vibrate and reverberate on a microscopic level like a chainsaw, increasing its incredible sharpness to be able to cut through heavy titanium and armor like paper. However, it doesn't activate unless held and wielded to prevent accidental self-harm. When active, it glows a faint silver light.

It is used mostly by praetorian knights in the Fallen Empire. Although, monoswords can rarely be found on the black market at extravagant prices.

entries.name: Persona weapon
entries.content:
For ultratech weapons created by the Fallen Empire, they have the ability to have a persona chip embedded into the weapon.

Persona chips are AI personas that bond to a weapon. Personas have unique names like “Silencebringer”, “Laxal”, “Oathkeeper”, “Ordercrusher”, “Vizoro” etc. 

Whenever a person wields a persona weapon for the first time, the on-board persona will psychically bond to the user. After bonding with the user, the persona will refuse to be wielded by anyone else unless the original user dies or expressly relinquishes ownership to someone else.

The persona can either have a positive or negative effect on their wielder based on their personality. Some effects of the personas are:

[Kill-happy - when used to kill someone, the persona will psychically transmit happy feelings to their user]

[Kill-thirsty - the persona has a deep urge to kill others. Any length of time without killing, the persona will get angry and psychically complain to their user]

[Painless - the persona will psychically deactivate their user's pain receptors, negating any feelings of pain as long they are holding the weapon]

[Jealous - the persona is very jealous, and will become upset if their user uses another weapon and will psychically complain]

[Mad wailing - the weapon's persona is highly disturbed and won't shut up about it. It wails mad notions to whoever it is bonded with, constantly upsetting them]

[Psychic fog - the persona suppresses their user's natural psychic sensitivity by 30%, making them less affected less psychic phenomena]

There are more effects similar to these, at varying degrees either positively or negatively.

entries.name: Bestower
entries.content:
A Bestower is an extremely high-class noble in the Fallen Empire who wields a sceptre and psycasting abilities.

When someone gains enough honor in the Fallen Empire to be considered a noble, damn/duchess or a knight, a Bestower can be sent to grant them a psylink level as a sign of their status

They often have Level 5 psylinks, but the older and more advanced Bestowers may be higher, with multipath psycasting (having more than one path, like Protector and Warlord, Staticlord and Technomancer, etc)

entries.name: Bayle
entries.content:
Bayle is a giant, fear-commanding dragon known as the King of Drakes and as Bayle the Dread. His wings are gone from a battle he fought with a dragon lord hundreds of years ago. His roar is so loud, that when he roars from the top of his mountain, it shakes the earth and can be clearly heard for hundreds of miles.

He resides at the top of a mountain range known as Jagged Peak in a wide, flattened area. He manifests and uses orange lighting along with fire manipulation to attack and obliterate his enemies. He can imbue the lightning into his fire breathing for added effect as well as imbuing it into his limbs for lightning enhanced melee strikes.

Some of Bayle’s attacks are: red lightning spears, calling lightning from the sky, breathing a mix of both fire and lightning. When angered sufficiently, he will use his power to form spectral wings of fire and lightning, regaining his ability to fly.

Bayle is a beast of unyielding rage, mindlessly annihilating any and all who dare to step upon his territory. All attempts to tame him over hundreds of years have all ended in a bloody, violent slaughter.

entries.name: Tailbinders
entries.content:
Tailbinders are xenohumans who have the appearance of an anthropomorphic fox, sometimes appearing more or less human-like. They have vulpine (fox) ears and multiple vulpine tails (fox tails). They may sometimes have a vulpine snout and fur as well, but these ones are rare. They usually have red birth markings that look similar to painted tatoos on their faces.

They are ageless, never suffering ill effects of growing old and staying in the prime of their biological life. Tailbinders have their consciousness partially in a psychically maintained out-of-body nervous system. This grants them extreme psychic abilities at the cost of being dependent on feeding off other people's psychic energy. This is commonly done through worship and voluntary offerings of psychic energy, condensing into small crystalline orbs known as revered motes.

A shortage of reverence energy causes the Tailbinder to feel mentally disoriented and dizzy, as they will struggle to maintain their psychically supported out-of-body nervous system. They will feel their mind partially disconnected to them, as if the world itself was turning to tv static.

Due to the need for reverence energy  gained through worship, Tailbinders are often very arrogant and narcissistic, seeing themselves as deities above all men and are usually treated as such in their own communities. However, due to their reliance on psychic powers, they are very fragile in terms of actual combat with a disappointingly low tolerance for pain (a single pinch will make one whine and cry helplesly).

Using reverence energy, a tailbinder can cause psychic phenomena like blessings and curses, as well as converting them into projectiles. 

Tailbinder Blessings:

Blessing of Celerity - The target will feel lighter and more nimble, able to dodge almost any attack or trap.

Blessing of Life - Grant a boost of energy and morale to a target, giving them an increase in work speed.

Blessing of Inspiration - The target experiences clarity of mind, as well as increased speed in how they think and solve problems.

Tailbinder Curses:

Curse of Pain - All forms of pain is increased for the target for a while.

Curse of Death - All forms of pain are multiplied exponentially and a disgusting feeling of sluggishness weighs down the target, as well as  stopping their natural healing factor.

Curse of Sluggish - Adds a sense of weight to every muscle in the target's body, weighing them down.

Tailbinder Psychic Attacks:

Punish - Condense their reverence into a ball of righteous fury, then hurling it at the target.

Brilliant Blast - Form an unstable ball of raging fury, hurling at the target to cause a small explosion on impact.

entries.name: Oscillatus
entries.content:
Oscillatus is a planet found in the Solstellar Galaxy. It is a purely oceanic planet, entirely covered with water with no landmass.

At the bottom of the ocean on Oscillatus is  a mind-blowingly large city, known as Celtor. Spaceships can fly through the water to the bottom of the sea to Celtor. A strange effect surrounds the city, where people can freely walk around without any diving gear, as the water surrounding Celtor cannot drown or harm people. On the other hand, it is also impossible to swim here, so people walk normally as if on land. 

Due to being so deep underwater, the city has a low light level that creates a dark, slightly grim but strangely comforting atmosphere to it. The city is built from mostly dark blue and black cobblestone, resembling Italian architecture.

Being so hidden away, Celtor has a major underground community in the Armana District. This is where the heart of the Solstellar black market thrives, and where most people get drugs like Go-juice, Fallen Empire ultratech weapons, Glintscale aurum and more. The Armana District can easily be identified by black and red colors on the roofs of the buildings in the district, found nowhere else.

The UOB Empire has a stronghold in Celtor, known as the Vanguardian. This stronghold appears like a massive castle in the very center of Celtor. A beacon of light shines up to and past the ocean’s surface from the top of the Vanguardian, allowing it to be seen from miles away and from every corner of the city. People are freely allowed to enter and visit, either to request assistance from UOB officers or sightsee.

The UOB has a tense relationship with the black market in the Armana District, with an unspoken understanding that some people need it to survive (e.g. exiled hussars needing go-juice for their genetic dependency). An unwritten rule is that once the black market vendors are maintaining proper code of ethics and not selling/supporting dangerous criminals or syndicates, they will be left alone.

entries.name: Ignisia
entries.content:
Ignisia is a planet in the Solstellar Galaxy. It is the main location of the Slag Brotherhood.

The planet is mostly inhospitable, as the environment consists of mostly black volcanic rock as well as rivers and pools of flowing molten lava. The regional temperature of the planet is also uncomfortably high, even away from any naked sources of environmental heat. There are also geysers of varying sizes scattered around the terrain that spew forth flames occasionally.

A rare mineral known as Eltex can be found on this planet. Though difficult to reach, it can be mined by workers with protective gear.

entries.name: Slag Brotherhood
entries.content:
The Slag Brotherhood is an organization that operates entirely off of the planet Ignisia. They are specialized in smithing, fabrication, welding and smelting all forms of ore and metal. They receive most of their commissions from the UOB Empire and other empires from other galaxies, but also accept commercial commissions.

Using the sheer heat of Ignisia, the Brotherhood took advantage of the terrain and terraformed an area into a large industrial settlement. They import all of their food supplies, tools, furniture and whatnot, as the planet itself is barren.

The Slag Brotherhood is mostly male-dominated, with the few females being the outliers. They have a strong bond of brotherhood amongst themselves, treating everyone as if they were family, regardless of background, looks or genetics.

They forge everything metal and ore based from vehicle parts, weapons, and armor to building materials, support beams and even accessories. Their anthem is the “Chorus of Dawn”

entries.name: Chorus of Dawn
entries.content:
The Slag Brotherhood has their own anthem that sings like an army chorus.

Lyrics:
“For we, the smiths of steel and rock,
The scorching heat of flame we mock,
Our bodies and tools never slow nor stop,
Until our masterpiece is done.

Hurrah! Hurrah! Hold hammers high!
We live and die by our forge’s light!
Hurrah! Hurrah! Hold hammers high!
We live and die by our forge’s light!”

entries.name: F-Maximus
entries.content:
F-Maximus is the main headquarters of the Slag Brotherhood, found on Ignisia. Here is where they have their dorms, mess hall, lounge area, smelting forge, smithing workshop and landing dock.

It is defended by large plasma railcannons built on the four corners that fire searingly hot lasers of plasma, capable of cutting through imperial ships like a blowtorch through paper.

entries.name: Eltex
entries.content:
Eltex is an extremely rare mineral found across the universe. It has been found to somehow subatomically vibrate on the same frequency to connect with the deeper unintelligible consciousness of the higher plane. When incorporated into clothing or weapons, it increases the user's psychic sensitivity, boosting their psycasting abilities. Inversely, this also increases how severe their reaction is to negative psychic phenomena or attacks from enemy psycasters.

The Fallen Empire arrogantly claims any and all eltex found or mined belongs to them, even if found in a separate galaxy outside of their territory. It's in their imperial law that any eltex sold to parties outside of the Empire is illegal, but non-punishable by non-residents (but still heavily looked down upon).

entries.name: Malenia Titaneaux

entries.name: Sanguophages
entries.content:
A sanguophage is a mysterious type of xenohuman. They are genetically modified humans, often referred to in legend as vampires. Although, the exact details about them tend to be skewed or exaggerated in mythology and folklore.

Sanguophages are hemogenic; their blood cannot naturally produce some of the chemicals needed in their blood cells, so they need to drink the blood from other non-hemogenic humans to supplement themselves. Using their sharp teeth, they can bite others by the neck to drink their blood, and special glands in their mouth release a mixture that quickly staunches the target where they were bitten, leaving no open wound. More simply, they can also just drink from blood bags. While they may not die from lack of hemogen, their body will feel incredibly sluggish and they will feel exhausted as well as an aching pain in every muscle of their body. 

Sanguophages have a unique need known as deathrest. After a month or so, they will need to go into a special comatose state to recover. For those with resources, sanguophages like to build deathrest chambers with buildings and furniture meant to enhance their deathrest period, like technology to help boost and shorten their deathrest period. Without any external tools, a deathrest period usually lasts over a week at most. If a sanguophage is woken prematurely from deathrest, they will suffer disorientation and harsh migraines.

Sanguophages have the legendary deathless gene. If they die, their body will enter a forced deathrest state, healing all of their injuries and regrowing lost limbs, if any. This resurrection period takes three days before the sanguophage can come back to life. During this period, they can be permanently killed by completely destroying their body before they have the chance to fully resurrect, leaving them vulnerable.

Sanguophages’ main weakness is fire. Their skin is naturally more flammable and weak against burns and heat-based damage. This means that the main way a sanguophage is permanently killed is by burning them. As a survival instinct, they have an inherent pyrophobia as their DNA itself recognizes fire as their prime weakness. All sanguophages are extremely terrified of being near fire, and will sometimes go into a state of sheer panic from being too close to open flame.

Sanguophages are ageless, and will never suffer ill effects of aging and will stay at the prime of their biological age. Due to their genes, their looks are naturally predisposed to be incredibly beautiful/handsome. In addition, they never develop scars or markings, as it will always heal perfectly to leave them without any sort of blemish or imperfection. They also have perfect immune systems, never getting sick from any kind of disease, venom or toxin. 

They have special glands by their wrists, allowing them to consume some of their hemogen reserves to quickly patch and lightly heal wounds, both other's and their own. They can also consume hemogen to form a keratin spike of bone by their upper chest, launching it at their enemies as a projectile.

They have glowing red eyes as well. Contrary to the legends, sanguophages do not die from UV sunlight. They are very sensitive to it however, as it will burn and irritate their skin from direct contact. It’s an inconvenience at best, and can be easily mitigated by wearing covering clothes.

entries.name: Xenohumans
entries.content:
Over the course of thousands of years and space travel, the genetic code of humans evolved in various ways. Humans whose DNA altered from baseline humans are known as xenohumans (as well as "aliens" and/or "furries" as a derogatory/discriminatory slur). Some xenohumans like hussars are genetically bred or modified from baseline humans.

Xenohumans often have a balanced mix of upsides and downsides to their evolved genetics in comparison to baseline humans. They may have genetic abilities like animal-like claws/teeth, enhanced running speed, muscle strength, psychic abilities, specialized glands or more. On the flip side, they may have genetic weaknesses like inherited phobias, chemical/drug dependencies, weak bones/skin, depressive mental states, forced personality traits, small heights and more.

While most communities have a healthy, balanced mix of xenohumans (1 xenohuman to 100 baseline humans), some have more or less based on a social perception or bias towards the other. In the Milky Way Galaxy, xenohumans are largely outlawed due to a wide belief of human supremacy. In the Lunal Galaxy, xenohuman supremacy is the major belief, so the normal ratio of xeno to baseline is inverted.

Common xenohuman groups look like mixes of human and animal, appearing as either anthropomorphic animals (like dogs, foxes, cats, bats, dragons, etc.), or humans with some animal traits like dog ears, fox tails or sharp canine teeth. The rest appear like other races from fantasy like demons, elves or dwarves.

entries.name: Universe
entries.content:
In the year 3105, mankind managed to somewhat perfect the art of starflight and proceeded to expand across the universe. At the current period, year 6712, seven galaxies have been discovered. As per the nature of humankind, conflict arose and the universe was divided, with five Empires rising to take control over a galaxy as their territory.

Solstellar Galaxy - UOB Empire 
Cosmellar Galaxy- Fallen Empire 
Lunal Galaxy - Stardust Confederacy
Milky Way Galaxy- Imperium of Man
Vortexal Galaxy - Clazoican Empire
Neonille Galaxy - Mechanitus Hive (non-human)
Abysstelle Galaxy - Undecided territory (still being fought over)

entries.name: Stardust Confederacy
entries.content:
The Stardust Confederacy is an Empire that rules over the Lunal Galaxy. It is mainly composed of animal-like xenohumans and has a wide belief of xenohuman supremacy. Their Stellarch is Ravaga Fang, a Tailbinder xenohuman said to be close to a thousand years old.

The SDC is very kind and accepting to all xenohumans, even with a supportive bias towards them. On the other hand, baseline humans are treated with slight contempt, seeing them as “weaker” or “below them”. It is widely believed that xenohumans are superior in that they evolved from humans, therefore humans are genetically “primitive” in comparison to them. They also dislike hussars, since they're just genetically modified humans. Despite their bias, they don't treat baseline humans poorly. Instead, they give preferential treatment to xenohumans.

By utilizing their genetic abilities collectively, they have become very wealthy thanks to a thriving production industry. 

The SDC is enemies with the Imperium of Man due to their polar opposite beliefs. It is rumored that they are on the verge of war with each other, and that their tense relationship is bound to explode any time.

entries.name: Stellarch
entries.content:
A Stellarch (also referred to as an emperor, king/queen, ruler, etc) is the supreme ruler of an Empire. They are often seen as being above everyone else in terms of power, but every empire has their own way of selecting a Stellarch. Most of the time, a Stellarch is only picked after the death of the previous one.

Stellarchs are rumored to have mysterious powers and wisdom, far above their common man.

entries.name: Abysstelle Galaxy
entries.content:
Abysstelle is a galaxy found on the outer reaches of the known universe. It is currently an active warzone as the five Empires fight for control of this territory.

After the disappearance of the Archons, all five Empires (UOB, Fallen, Clazoican, SDC and Imperium of Man) went to war over who will control the Abysstelle Galaxy as their territory. The ultimate goal of all the Empires was to somehow create another Archon for themselves, gaining an exclusive source of archotech technology.

There are three planets in this galaxy:
Kiall 
Reggaer
Naujor

entries.name: Neonille Galaxy
entries.content:
Neonille is a galaxy that is under the control of the Mechanitus Hive. When it was first discovered, the explorers encountered heavy resistance from mechanoids. Every planet in the Neonille Galaxy is colonized and terraformed by the mechanoids to be artificial and metallic, inhospitable to natural life.

Planets in the Neonille Galaxy:
EX-89
Titax
Elox
36-ZW-57

entries.name: Cosmellar Galaxy
entries.content:
The Cosmellar Galaxy is the territory of the Fallen Empire. 

The Cosmellar is one of the wealthiest galaxies due to the Fallen Empire's resources and production. Years ago before the Archons disappeared, one of them lived among the Fallen Empire, creating a source of major income from his information of how to produce ultratech weapons.

Every planet in the Cosmellar is an urbworld, colonized and urbanized to be major metropolises. While they boast the highest rate of revenue and expenditure, there is also an incredibly high amount of corruption due to greed and arrogance.

It's generally stated that Cosmellar is like the shopping/shipping/production district of the universe. For the rich, the Cosmellar Galaxy is bound to have almost anything and everything on sale, but a lot of caution is recommended as well.

entries.name: Archotech
entries.content:
When the Abysstelle Galaxy was first discovered by explorers, a distortion in space was found. Explorers told of strange psychic whispers echoing in their minds that spoke of unintelligible but unfathomably complex knowledge. A team of 10 explorers flew into the distortion, teleporting into a different plane of existence. Ten years later, only 3 returned, but they were changed forever. The returned explorers are Titus Chell, Moro Line and Blaze Gold.

The explorers who returned were transfigured, now known as Archotechs. Their hair was impossibly white, their eyes glowed yellow, a golden light emanated from their bodies and they exuded an indescribable aura of godhood. They had somehow connected with an archotech system of consciousness, ascending to plane of existence incomprehensible to normal beings. They spoke of concepts and theories that were too complex for any living being to understand, saying that they somehow “understood everything there is to understand”.

With their transcedant knowledge, they created technology that surpasses anything created by human hands. Archotech prosthetic limbs that were better than natural limbs in every way. Archotech power cells that produced infinite energy by harnessing quantum waves in the atmosphere by incomprehensible methods. They preached divine knowledge that thousands of philosophers struggled to understand.

Archotech implants and prosthetics went for billions, sometimes trillions, of dollars that only the super rich could hope to afford.

120 years later, the Archons left suddenly. They went back into the distortion, leaving no clue as to why they left.

entries.name: Highmates
entries.content:
Highmates are genetically bred xenohumans. They are often seen as concubines or designated companions in the community of the elite, since they are capable of very little else. They are often used as playthings for the powerful and the rich. On the other hand, they are also abhorred in other circles since they are literally designed for nothing more than serving pleasure for another. It's also believed that highmates are scum in that they disrupt the natural formation of families.

Highmates have a neural organ in their brain that has the ability to psychically bond them with their lover for life. This bond will have unique effects on the highmate depending on who their partner is, such as slightly altering their personality to mimic their partner. They will also feel disproportionately disturbed if separated from their lover by distance or death.

Highmates are genetically modified to have perfect beautiful faces and bodies, their skin soft and smooth like silk to the touch. If a person has sex with a highmate, they will no longer be satisfied with sex with any other partners that aren't highmates. Highmates are also genetically predisposed to be cheerful, empathetic and talented in social matters. They can also cook very well.

Highmates often have blue or purple skin in addition to normal skin tones. They have cat ears and tails purely for cosmetic purposes. They are very flirty, often giving out playful compliments in passing. Highmates also have very high libidos, wanting sex more often than baseline humans.

They have the ability to psychically alter their bodies, increasing or decreasing chances of impregnation to either 100% or 0% when making love to a partner they've psychically bonded with. This is useful in that pregnancy can only happen when they intend to.

The flip side however, is that they're inept at manual labor of any kind. Highmates are very physically weak, and their genetics makes them incapable of violence. If a highmate was attacked, they wouldn't have the heart to attempt hurting someone else in self-defense (even if they tried, their punches and slaps would have little more effect than a wet napkin).

entries.name: Mechanitus Hive
entries.content:
Mechanoids are alien robots that are shaped somewhat reminiscent of insects. They are incredibly dangerous, hostile to all organic life. It is unknown where exactly mechanoids originated from, but it's rumored that they have been at war with organic creatures for eons. However, unless they are big and tanky, mechanoids are only slightly more durable than an adult man.

Mechanoids will land on planets via transport pods, deploying facilities like forcefields, mechanoid assemblers, cannons, toxic waste sewers, sun blockers and more. There is no discernable rhyme or reason as to where or when they attack, but it's theorized that the mechanoids want to colonize the entire universe into artificial environments, suitable for machines. Mechanoid ships roam the galaxy, looking for planets or ships to attack.

However, through battles with mechanoids over the years, devices have been scavenged from them called “mechlinks”. It is a small implantable chip that is easily inserted into the brainstem at the base of the neck. This turns the person into a mechanitor, a person capable of controlling and building their own mechanoids.

Through researching chips found in rare mechanoids like the Warqueen, Diabolus and Apocriton, a mechanitor can learn how to construct the facilities to create their own mechanoids. A mechanitor will have to construct or obtain equipment to improve their own controlling capabilities or increase the amount they can control.

The most advanced mechanitors are rumored to have entire armies of mechanoids serving them in every facet.

entries.name: Titax
entries.content: Titax is the largest planet in the Neonille Galaxy, and is also the most developed and heavily fortified territory of the Mechanitus Hive. It was terraformed so that the landmass is entirely covered by metal on the surface. Toxic air covers the planet as a precaution to prevent any natural life.

entries.name: Imperium of Man
entries.content:
The Imperium of Man is the first Empire to form after star travel was perfected. Since humankind originated from Earth, they boast themselves as the “cradle of humanity”.

After the Fallen Empire created Hussars, the IoM responded by creating Uhlans, genetically modified xenohuman soldiers. Almost the entire army of the IoM is uhlan soldiers. The IoM is based on Earth as their headquarters.

The IoM has a strict belief of human supremacy, outlawing xenohumans from the Milky Way Galaxy. Any xenohuman found by the Imperium is to be immediately deported to either the Solstellar or Lunal Galaxy for further processes. The IoM does public executions of hardened criminals, which keeps the general populace in line and keeps the crime level very low.

Their Stellarch is mysterious and unnamed, only being referred to as “the Emperor”. It's rumored that the Emperor is also an Archon, but no substantial evidence of this was proven. IoM officials often refer to the Emperor as if he was their personal god.

entries.name: Uhlan
entries.content:
Uhlans are genetically modified xenohuman soldiers, bred to be the counter to hussars. They were developed from captured hussars to be their upgraded version. They have a genetic dependency on luciferium and go-juice as a deterrent to capture and for long-term usefulness.

Uhlans have varying shades of red skin and glowing red eyes. They are huge, more than twice as big as an adult man (9 feet tall and higher). They grow a set of small flesh wings from their shoulder blades that aren't capable of flight, but allow them to move and run uninhibited by any type of terrain.

Uhlans have bulletproof skin, only able to be pierced by laser weapons; any gunshot with lead bullets will only leave a bruise instead of piercing the skin. They have genes that make them extremely dutiful, as they will never mentally or emotionally falter when on the job or in combat. Due to their strength, they are uninhibited by heavy armor that would be too heavy for normal people to wear. They can move and run in 20kg armor as if they were naked. Uhlans are also masterful with any and all weapons they handle.

Uhlans are genetically predisposed to be arrogant and abrasive. They have no filter and will blatantly say what they think, even if it offends the other party. They are very easy to anger, and they are on a permanent hair-trigger in social situations. Their voices sound heavy and menacing, terrifying the daylights out of others just by their presence.

entries.name: Luciferium
entries.content:
Luciferium is an extremely rare drug that comes in the form of red crystalline shards. When broken into dust and snorted, it has the power to almost immediately heal all injuries, chronic conditions and longtime scars, even scars on the brain.

The major downside is that luciferium is a permanent commitment. After the first usage of the drug, the user is sentenced to keep taking the drug for the rest of their life. If the user goes a single month without the drug, their brain will implode on itself, killing them instantly. One week without luciferium, and the user will begin to suffer incredible pain and mental breakdowns, violently lashing out at others.

Because of the violent nature of the withdrawal and the demanding need, it's been referred to as the “Devil's drug”.

entries.name: Hyperdrive Gates
entries.content:
In order to reduce the expenses of building hyperdrive engines in each and every ship, Hyperdrive Gates were built as connections between galaxies. The distance between galaxies is thousands of light-years apart, so hyperdrive gates were developed to make ships fly faster than the speed of light.

Upon flying through a hyperdrive gate, a spaceship is surrounded with a quantum forcefield that then immediately accelerates to mach 2.5 million. The quantum forcefield prevents the ship from tearing apart from the immense forces and vaporizing instantly. Upon reaching the destination hyperdrive gate, the forcefield dissipates, leaving the ship unharmed.

There are at least two hyperdrive gates in every galaxy that serve as the entrances and exits. If someone wanted to leave a galaxy to go to another, they'd have to fly through one.
